info.title: GenAI Output Messages
info.description: Schema for the gen_ai.output.messages attribute, describing the messages generated by a GenAI model or agent.

OutputMessages.description: Represents the list of output messages generated by the model or agent.
x-otel-deviation: The deprecated finish_reason field is omitted. Finish reasons belong in gen_ai.response.finish_reasons.
Allow ExtractOutputMessage in addition to ChatMessage, since `gen_ai.extract` operations return typed answers instead of chat messages.

ExtractOutputMessage.description: Represents the response of a `gen_ai.extract` operation: the response body as the provider returned it, without the model and the usage. Other keys of the response body are permitted. The array holds exactly one such message.
x-otel-deviation: OTel does not define this message or any of the definitions it references.

answers.description: One answer for each field in the input, keyed by field name.

truncated.description: Whether an answer is incomplete or invalid. Not all providers return it. Leave the key out when the provider does not return it.

state_text.description: The text that the spans index into, if the provider returns it.

ExtractAnswer.description: Represents the answer for one field. The field type sets which keys the provider returns. Other keys are permitted.

value.description: The extracted value. It is null when the model cannot determine the field.

guess.description: The best candidate that is not null. The provider returns it also when the value is null.

valid.description: Whether the generated answer agrees with the field spec. When it does not, `value` is null.

complete.description: Whether the generation of the answer ended normally.

decoder.description: The decoder that produced the value.

tokens.description: The number of output tokens for this answer, including retries.

raw.description: The raw JSON that the model generated.

p_null.description: The probability, from 0 to 1, that the value is null.

p_nulls.description: For a list answer, the probability of null for each item.

confidence.description: The probability, from 0 to 1, of the returned value, or of `guess` when the answer has one.

confidences.description: For a list answer, the confidence for each item.

log_probability.description: The log probability of the generated answer.

span.description: The location of the value in the text, or null when the value has no unique location.

spans.description: For a list answer, the location of each item in the text, or null for an item that has no unique location.

property_spans.description: For a list of objects, one map for each item. The map gives the location of each property value in the text, or null, keyed by property name.

printed_value.description: The text as printed in the input, for a field with `source_only`.

failure_reason.description: The reason why the answer is invalid, such as `not_in_source`.

retry_input_tokens.description: The number of input tokens that the retries for this field used.

unit.description: The unit of a duration value.

quantiles.description: The percentiles of an estimate, when the caller asks for them.

steps.description: For a forecast, one estimate for each step.

ExtractSpan.description: Represents a [start, end] pair of character offsets into state, or into state_text if the provider returns it. The end offset is exclusive.
